policy: Index only providers whose official website confirms identity, primary location, fine-art appraisal relevance, and useful provider-specific facts. All other profiles remain under review and are excluded from discovery surfaces.

open-to-the-public.name: Open to the Public
open-to-the-public.title: Open to the Public — Los Angeles Fine-Art Appraiser
open-to-the-public.description: Open to the Public is a Los Angeles fine-art appraisal and consulting firm specializing in postwar and contemporary art and photography.
open-to-the-public.about: Open to the Public is a Los Angeles-based fine-art appraisal and consulting firm led by Kaycee Olsen. Its official website states that the practice prepares USPAP-compliant appraisals and specializes in postwar and contemporary art and photography.
specialties: Paintings, prints, sculpture, and works on paper
open-to-the-public.qualifications: The official website identifies Kaycee Olsen as an Accredited Member of the Appraisers Association of America and describes the firm's appraisal work as USPAP-compliant.

heidi-vaughan-ma-isa-am.name: Heidi Vaughan Fine Art
heidi-vaughan-ma-isa-am.title: Heidi Vaughan Fine Art — Houston Art Appraisals
heidi-vaughan-ma-isa-am.description: Heidi Vaughan Fine Art is a Houston art gallery and advisory that provides fine-art appraisals for insurance, estates, donations, and equitable distribution.
heidi-vaughan-ma-isa-am.about: Heidi Vaughan Fine Art is a Houston gallery, art advisory, and consulting firm located in the Upper Kirby district. Its official website confirms fine-art appraisal work for insurance, estate planning, equitable distribution, and charitable donations.
heidi-vaughan-ma-isa-am.qualifications: The official website identifies Heidi Vaughan as an Accredited Member of the International Society of Appraisers in Fine Arts and states that the practice is USPAP compliant.

sarah-ann-wilson-art-services.name: Wilson Art Services, LLC
sarah-ann-wilson-art-services.title: Wilson Art Services — Philadelphia Fine-Art Appraiser
sarah-ann-wilson-art-services.description: Wilson Art Services is a Philadelphia fine-art appraisal and consulting practice offering confidential appraisals, collection planning, and advisory services.
sarah-ann-wilson-art-services.about: Wilson Art Services, LLC is a Philadelphia-based independent fine-art appraisal and consulting practice founded by Sarah Ann Wilson. The official website confirms appraisal, collection-planning, advisory, curating, and donation services.
sarah-ann-wilson-art-services.qualifications: The official website identifies Sarah Ann Wilson as an Accredited Member of the Appraisers Association of America in Impressionist and Modern Art.

afp-art-consulting-llc-fine-art-consulti.name: AFP Art Consulting, LLC
afp-art-consulting-llc-fine-art-consulti.title: AFP Art Consulting — Boston Fine-Art Appraisals
afp-art-consulting-llc-fine-art-consulti.description: AFP Art Consulting is a Boston fine-art appraisal and consulting firm offering USPAP-aligned appraisals, research, advisory, and collection management.
afp-art-consulting-llc-fine-art-consulti.about: AFP Art Consulting, LLC is a Boston-based fine-art appraisal and consulting firm founded by Andrea Foggle Plotkin. Its official website confirms appraisal, advisory, research, writing, collection-management, and exhibition-curation work.
afp-art-consulting-llc-fine-art-consulti.qualifications: The official website states that AFP Art Consulting prepares appraisals under USPAP and American Society of Appraisers professional standards and identifies Andrea Foggle Plotkin's appraisal-studies certificate.

st-lifer-art-inc-international-art-appra.name: St. Lifer Art, Inc.
st-lifer-art-inc-international-art-appra.title: St. Lifer Art — New York Fine-Art Appraiser
st-lifer-art-inc-international-art-appra.description: St. Lifer Art is a New York fine-art appraisal firm specializing in nineteenth-, twentieth-, and twenty-first-century paintings, prints, photography, posters, and sculpture.
st-lifer-art-inc-international-art-appra.about: St. Lifer Art, Inc. is a New York-based fine-art appraisal firm led by Jane St. Lifer. Its official website confirms work with private collectors, artists' estates, and corporate collections, with a focus on nineteenth-, twentieth-, and twenty-first-century art.
specialties: American, European, Asian, Israeli, Latin American, and Russian art
st-lifer-art-inc-international-art-appra.qualifications: The official website identifies Jane St. Lifer as an Accredited Senior Appraiser with the American Society of Appraisers and states that reports follow ASA and USPAP requirements.
